environmentEn: bright miniature subway carriage with smooth flat slate floor (zero raised circular Lego floor studs), teal commuter seat, steel-blue window band, and overhead amber strap handles
environmentZh: 明亮微缩地铁车厢，平整深灰无凸点地板（严禁乐高地面凸粒）、青绿色单人座位、冷蓝车窗带与琥珀色刚性吊环扶手

shots.actionEn: Mo pivots only its 1:1 cylindrical head toward the last empty teal subway seat on screen right while Noob stands still near the left edge
shots.actionZh: Mo仅沿颈部刚性转轴猛地转头盯向右侧最后一个青绿色空座位，左侧边缘Noob保持静止
shots.faceEn: Mo switches from sleepy eyes to wide hollow shocked ring eyes (O_O); Noob keeps flat Chill (-_-) decal
shots.faceZh: Mo切换为震惊白圈眼(O_O)2D贴图；Noob保持平面死鱼眼(-_-)
shots.cameraEn: Medium two-plane framing, crisp dolly push-in toward the empty teal seat
shots.cameraZh: 中景双层构图，向青绿空座轻快推镜
shots.sfx: 地铁行驶低频声 + 清脆叮声
shots.caption: 早高峰最后一个空座！

shots.actionEn: Mo sprints two stiff Motor6D strides across the smooth subway aisle toward the empty teal seat as the carriage jolts
shots.actionZh: 车厢微晃瞬间，Mo迈开两步干脆僵直的Motor6D方腿大步冲向青绿色空座位
shots.faceEn: determined focused 2D eyes with a single painted blue sweat drop
shots.faceZh: 专注大眼配额角一滴2D蓝色汗珠贴图
shots.cameraEn: Static carriage-relative medium-full shot across the aisle
shots.cameraZh: 横跨过道的车厢内固定中全景机位
shots.sfx: 车厢顿挫声 + 两声清脆塑料踏步声
shots.caption: 冲啊！这把稳了

shots.actionEn: Noob drops squarely onto the teal seat in one rigid 90-degree R6 hip pivot right before Mo reaches the cushion
shots.actionZh: 就在Mo差半步够到坐垫前，Noob做一次干净的90度R6刚性髋轴折弯稳稳抢先落座
shots.faceEn: unchanging deadpan Chill (-_-) decal on Noob; frozen shocked O_O decal on Mo
shots.faceZh: Noob全程保持毫无波澜的死鱼眼(-_-)贴图；Mo定格为震惊圆圈眼(O_O)
shots.cameraEn: Locked-off medium shot centered on the teal seat
shots.cameraZh: 聚焦青绿座位的固定中景机位
shots.caption: 黄皮新手：丝滑截胡

shots.actionEn: suspended above the floor with its raised flat solid 1x2x1 block hand docked flush beneath the overhead amber strap handle, Mo swings once by 8 degrees like a rigid plastic keychain beside seated Noob
shots.actionZh: 双脚离地悬空的Mo以高举的1x2x1实心平头方柱手刚性贴合车顶琥珀吊环底面，像一枚硬质塑料钥匙扣一样整体轻摆8度，身旁Noob淡定端坐
shots.faceEn: synchronized deadpan horizontal line eyes (-_-) on both Mo and Noob
shots.faceZh: Mo与Noob同步定格为沉默死鱼眼(-_-)2D贴图
shots.cameraEn: Locked-off medium-full two-shot showing overhead strap rail and gap under Mo's feet
shots.cameraZh: 收入车顶吊环横杆与Mo脚下悬空缝隙的固定双人中全景
shots.sfx: 黑胶急停 + 塑料挂件轻晃叮声
shots.caption: 喜提早高峰塑料挂件体验卡
